title: Promotion configuration
description: Template-specific values referenced from the promotion DSL as config.<key>. The assistant only writes these declared keys; existing undeclared keys are preserved and the ordinary admin JSON editor remains authoritative for backend-specific extensions.

rate.title: Rate
rate.description: Percentage applied by the DSL, where 90 means 90% (10% off).

amount.title: Amount
amount.description: Order discount amount in major currency units, as referenced by the DSL.

specification_ids.title: Specification IDs
specification_ids.description: Numeric specification IDs eligible for an item discount.

min_level.title: Minimum member level
min_level.description: Minimum profile level required by a member discount.

gift_spec_id.title: Gift specification ID
gift_spec_id.description: Numeric specification ID of a gift when the template DSL references config.gift_spec_id.

gift_qty.title: Gift quantity
gift_qty.description: Gift quantity when the template DSL references config.gift_qty.
